decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing efficient and evasive Spirit creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition. Collected Company is used to quickly refill the board with threats and maximize the deck's tempo advantage. The deck also includes some protection in the form of Selfless Spirit and Shacklegeist to ensure its creatures can keep attacking. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This deck focuses on control through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong presence on the battlefield with threats like Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also utilizes enchantments and lands that can provide additional utility and advantage. By controlling the pace of the game and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to grind out victories in a slower, more methodical manner.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Witch's Oven, Mayhem Devil, and Cauldron Familiar to create a recurring loop of sacrificing and dealing damage. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute allow for stealing and sacrificing the opponent's creatures. The key strategy is to maintain a constant flow of sacrificing creatures to trigger various effects and overwhelm the opponent with damage. The deck also includes some removal and card draw to support the aggressive sacrificing strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption spells to apply early pressure and disrupt opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser to quickly reduce opponent's life total and control the board with removal spells like Dreadbore and Fatal Push. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize for hand disruption and Chandra, Torch of Defiance for additional card advantage and burn damage. Its mana base includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear to support the game plan and provide flexibility in different situations.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence using flying Spirit creatures and tempo plays. By using cards like Rattlechains to protect creatures and Collected Company to refill the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The Azorius colors provide powerful disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition to control the game and take advantage of the opponent's misplays. The deck's synergy and speed allow it to apply pressure early and maintain control until victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing fast and efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Graveyard Trespasser, and Bonecrusher Giant to put immediate pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Dreadbore to control the board and remove threats. The deck's aggressive strategy is complemented by powerful finishers such as Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. With a mix of burn spells, removal, and strong threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a strong board presence with green creatures and ramp spells, while utilizing devotion to green to fuel powerful abilities and spells. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and generate large amounts of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, allowing for explosive turns and the ability to cast high-cost spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Voracious Hydra. Additionally, the deck includes utility cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset to control the board and disrupt the opponent's gameplan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, board wiping with Supreme Verdict, and generating card advantage with Narset and Teferi. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents. The deck also has a focus on stabilizing the board with Dream Trawler and creating threats with Shark Typhoon. The mana base is built to support the control game plan with various dual lands and utility lands. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control elements.

This aggressive white weenie deck focuses on overwhelming opponents with a wide array of low-cost creatures with powerful abilities like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Luminarch Aspirant, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The deck also includes cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Brave the Elements to further boost the team's power and protect them from removal spells. With a focus on efficiency and synergy, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure to the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost spells to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and other spells, then use cards like Ledger Shredder and Pieces of the Puzzle to bring back the Phoenixes from the graveyard. The deck also includes card draw and delve spells like Treasure Cruise to refill the hand and fuel the graveyard. The inclusion of strategic planning and Temporal Trespass adds additional flexibility and potential for explosive plays. Additional removal and protection spells help to control the board and ensure the deck can maintain its aggressive tempo.

This deck focuses on utilizing spells like Pieces of the Puzzle, Treasure Cruise, and Opt to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenix and bring them back for repeated attacks. Ledger Shredder and Thing in the Ice provide additional ways to trigger the Phoenix's ability, while Temporal Trespass can be a game-winning finisher. Strategic Planning helps dig for key cards, while Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal and disruption. The inclusion of lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City help ensure a smooth mana base for consistent aggression.

This Izzet Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal while drawing cards and finding its win conditions in Niv-Mizzet, Parun, Crackling Drake, and Thing in the Ice. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue opponents through efficient spellcasting and card advantage. Key cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Quicken help filter through the deck and find key pieces. With versatile removal options and powerful planeswalkers like Ral, Izzet Viceroy, the deck aims to outlast opponents and close out the game with its powerful threats.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly by playing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while also dealing direct damage with cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Overall, the main strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient threats while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss along with other cards to set up a combo with Parhelion II. The goal is to control the board through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also filling the graveyard with cards like Satyr Wayfinder and Grisly Salvage. Esika's Chariot and Witherbloom Command help generate value and create additional creatures on the board. The deck also includes cards like Tasigur, the Golden Fang and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for additional threats and removal options.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that fill up the graveyard quickly, allowing for repeatable combos with Greasefang and Parhelion II. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to set up its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells. Tasigur, the Golden Fang acts as a versatile threat while cards like Witherbloom Command and Grisly Salvage help dig for key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to create a synergistic combo engine while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on dealing fast and consistent damage to the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. Cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Goblin Chainwhirler, and Monastery Swiftspear put pressure on the opponent early, while spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire provide direct damage to finish off the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Soul-Scar Mage to punish opponents for casting spells. The mana base is optimized for fast and efficient casting of spells, ensuring a relentless assault on the opponent.
